title: Rick Brown
text:
I am currently an Assistant Professor Mathematics and the director of the data science program at Southern Utah University where I teach primarily statistics and data science courses.
I joined the faculty at SUU in Fall 2020 as a Lecturer of Mathematics before obtaining a tenure-track position in Fall 2023. Since being at SUU, I have assisted in developing the data science bachelor’s degree and getting it accreditedby ABET. I have taught and developed many different courses in my time at SUU.
I received a Bachelor’s of Science in Mathematics with an option in Statistics from California State University, Chico. I then obtained a Master’s of Science in Statistics from Colorado State University where I completed a project entitled A Study of Collaborative Funding from the National Institutes of Health From Social Network Perspectives with advisor Dr. Haonan Wang and co-advisor Stephen C. Hayne. After this, I worked as a Mathematical Statistician for the United States Census Bureau for a year before going back to graduate school. I earned a PhD in Applied Mathematics from the University of Montana with dissertation Semivariogram Methods for Modeling Whittle-Matérn Priors in Bayesian Inverse Problems with advisor Dr. John Bardsley.

title: K-Means Shiny App
text:
It may take a moment for the app to load.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600
library(shiny)
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # Put a titlePanel here
  titlePanel("k-means clustering"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    # Sidebar. Put your inputs inside the sidebarPanel
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput('xcol', 'X Variable', names(iris)),
      selectInput('ycol', 'Y Variable', names(iris),
                  selected=names(iris)[[2]]),
      numericInput('clusters', 'Cluster count', 3,
                   min = 1, max = 9)
    ),
    
    # Main panel. put your output plot here
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput('plot1')
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selectedData <- reactive({
    iris[, c(input$xcol, input$ycol)]
  })
  
  clusters <- reactive({
    kmeans(selectedData(), input$clusters)
  })
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    palette(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3",
              "#FF7F00", "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999"))
    
    par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 0, 1))
    plot(selectedData(),
         col = clusters()$cluster,
         pch = 20, cex = 3)
    points(clusters()$centers, pch = 4, cex = 4, lwd = 4)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

title: Guess the Correlation Shiny App
text:
It may take a moment for the app to load.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1100
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(shinyjs)

ui <- fluidPage(
  useShinyjs(),

  textInput("cor_guess", "Guess the correlation!"),

  actionButton("submit_guess", "Submit Guess"),
  actionButton("new_plot", "Generate New Plot"),
  actionButton("toggle_stats", "Hide Guess History"),

  br(), br(),

  plotOutput("graph"),

  textOutput("message"),

  plotlyOutput("stats"),

  br(),

  div(
    id = "reset_container",
    actionButton("reset_input", "Reset Game")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  vars <- reactiveValues(
    off_values = c(),
    show_stats = TRUE,
    true_cor = NULL
  )

  x_vals <- reactiveVal()
  y_vals <- reactiveVal()

  generate_data <- function() {

    x <- rnorm(100)

    target_cor <- runif(1, -0.95, 0.95)

    z <- rnorm(100)
    z <- scale(z - cor(z, x) * x)

    y <- target_cor * scale(x) + sqrt(1 - target_cor^2) * z

    x_vals(as.numeric(x))
    y_vals(as.numeric(y))
    vars$true_cor <- cor(x, y)
  }

  generate_data()

  output$graph <- renderPlot({

    df <- data.frame(
      x = as.numeric(x_vals()),
      y = as.numeric(y_vals())
    )

    req(nrow(df) > 0)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 1) +
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
  })

  # ---- MESSAGE ----
  output$message <- renderText({

    req(input$submit_guess)

    guess <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$cor_guess))
    req(!is.na(guess))

    paste0(
      "Your guess was ", guess, ".\n\n",
      "The true value was ", round(vars$true_cor, 3), ".\n",
      "That is a difference of ", round(abs(guess - vars$true_cor), 3), "."
    )
  })

  output$stats <- renderPlotly({

    req(vars$show_stats)

    if (length(vars$off_values) == 0) {

      p <- ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                 label = "Please make some guesses to see guess history.",
                 size = 6) +
        theme_void()

    } else {

      d <- data.frame(
        guess = seq_along(vars$off_values),
        error = round(vars$off_values, 5)
      )

      p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = guess, y = error)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_line() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
        labs(x = "Guess Number", y = "Error") 
    }

    ggplotly(p)
  })

  # ---- submit guess ----
  observeEvent(input$submit_guess, {

    guess <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(input$cor_guess))
    req(!is.na(guess))

    vars$off_values <- c(vars$off_values, guess - vars$true_cor)
  })

  # ---- new plot ----
  observeEvent(input$new_plot, {
    generate_data()
  })

  # ---- reset ----
  observeEvent(input$reset_input, {
    generate_data()
    vars$off_values <- c()
  })

  # ---- toggle ----
  observeEvent(input$toggle_stats, {

    vars$show_stats <- !vars$show_stats

    if (vars$show_stats) {
      shinyjs::show("stats")
      shinyjs::show("reset_container")
      updateActionButton(session, "toggle_stats",
                         label = "Hide Guess History")
    } else {
      shinyjs::hide("stats")
      shinyjs::hide("reset_container")
      updateActionButton(session, "toggle_stats",
                         label = "Show Guess History")
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
